<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" /></noinclude><section begin=par91 />2nd pers. ''m''. in pause {{GHGheb|text=־ֶ֫ כָה}}, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=כַּפֶּֽכָה}} (''thy hand''), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=139|verse=5}}, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=24|verse=10}}; once {{GHGheb|text=חֹנָ֑ךְ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=53|verse=6}} (cf. the analogous cases in the verbal suffix {{GHGpar|75|ll}}); {{GHGterm|fem.}} {{GHGheb|text=־ֵיךְ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=5|verse=12}} (in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=16|verse=53|hidebook=1}} also for {{GHGheb|text=שְׁבִיתַ֫יִךְ}} probably {{GHGheb|text=שְׁבִיתֵיךְ}} is intended), {{GHGheb|text=־ֵ֫ כִי}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=11|verse=15}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=103|verse=3}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=116|verse=19|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=135|verse=9|hidebook=1}} (corresponding to the Aramaic suffix of the ''2nd fem. sing.''; on the wholly abnormal {{GHGheb|text=־ֵ֫ כֵה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Na|chapter=2|verse=14}}, cf. ''l''), {{GHGheb|text=לֵכִי}} {{GHGterm|K<sup>e</sup>th.}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=4|verse=2}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ct|chapter=2|verse=13}}. Also {{GHGheb|text=־ָ֫ ךְ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=22|verse=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=23|verse=28}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=25|verse=4|hidebook=1}}.

3rd pers. {{GHGheb|text=־ֹה}} (cf. {{GHGpar|7|c}}), e.g. {{GHGheb|text=אָֽהֳלֹה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=9|verse=21}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=12|verse=8|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=13|verse=3|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=35|verse=21|hidebook=1}} (always with {{GHGterm|Q<sup>e</sup>rê}} {{GHGheb|text=אָֽהֳלוֹ}}); {{GHGheb|text=נֻחֹה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Nu|chapter=10|verse=36}}; {{GHGheb|text=לֵחֹה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=34|verse=7}}; {{GHGheb|text=בֻּלֹּה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=20|verse=7}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Na|chapter=2|verse=1}} {{GHGterm|Q<sup>e</sup>rê}}; {{GHGheb|text=קִצֹּה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=19|verse=23}} {{GHGterm|K<sup>e</sup>th.}}, for which {{GHGheb|text=קִצּוֹ}} is read in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=37|verse=24}}; {{GHGheb|text=עִירֹה}} and {{GHGheb|text=סוּתֹה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=49|verse=11}}, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=22|verse=26}} ({{GHGterm|Q<sup>e</sup>rê}} {{GHGheb|text=עִירוֹ}}, {{GHGheb|text=סוּתוֹ}}); {{GHGheb|text=סֻבֹּה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=10|verse=9}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=27|verse=5|hidebook=1}} {{GHGterm|K<sup>e</sup>th.}}; {{GHGheb|text=הֲמוֹנֹה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=31|verse=18}}, &c., {{GHGterm|K<sup>e</sup>th.}}; {{GHGheb|text=תְּבוּאָתֹה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=48|verse=18}} [altogether fourteen times in the Pentateuch, and some forty times in other books: see Driver, ''Samuel'', p. xxxv, and on {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=2|verse=9}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=21|verse=1|hidebook=1}}].

''3rd fem.'' {{GHGheb|text=־ָה}} for {{GHGheb|text=־ָהּ}} (with the softening of the ''Mappiq'', cf. {{GHGpar|23|k}}, and the analogous cases in {{GHGpar|58|g}}) occurs repeatedly before ''B<sup>e</sup>ghadhk<sup>e</sup>phath'' and other soft consonants, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=9|verse=18}} (before {{GHGheb|text=וְ}}, if the text is right), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=13|verse=4}} (before {{GHGheb|text=ל}}), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Nu|chapter=15|verse=28.31}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=1|verse=9}} (unless {{GHGheb|text=אָכְלָה}}, the infin. with fem. termination, is intended; {{GHGheb|text=שָׁתֹה}} follows), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=16|verse=44}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=24|verse=6|hidebook=1}} (before {{GHGheb|text=ב}}), {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=20|verse=20}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=8|verse=6}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=12|verse=28}} (before {{GHGheb|text=א}}), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Na|chapter=3|verse=9}} (before {{GHGheb|text=וּ}}), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=48|verse=14}} (before {{GHGheb|text=פ}}), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=47|verse=10}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=31|verse=22}} twice (before {{GHGheb|text=ת}}), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=21|verse=2}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=20|verse=17}} (before {{GHGheb|text=ה}}), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Nu|chapter=32|verse=42}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Am|chapter=1|verse=11}} (before {{GHGheb|text=ן}}), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=6|verse=2}} (before {{GHGheb|text=ע}}); even in {{GHGterm|pause}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=12|verse=4}}<sup> ''a''</sup> and <sup>5 b</sup>; {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=23|verse=17}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=21|verse=22}}, also with Zaqeph, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=45|verse=6}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=6|verse=6}} (probably), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=44|verse=19|hidebook=1}}; on {{GHGheb|text=הָשַּׁמָּה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=26|verse=34}}, &c., see {{GHGpar|67|y}}. Cf. also {{GHGheb|text=־ָא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=36|verse=5}}.—Sometimes the Masora appears (but this is very doubtful) to regard the {{GHGheb|text=־ָהּ}} with feminines as a shortening of {{GHGheb|text=־ָתָהּ}}, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=נִצָּהּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=40|verse=10}} for {{GHGheb|text=נִצָּ֫תָהּ}}, {{GHGheb|text=פִּנָּהּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=7|verse=8}} for {{GHGheb|text=פִּנָּ֫תָהּ}}; also {{GHGheb|text=־ָם}} for {{GHGheb|text=־ָתָם}} in {{GHGheb|text=כִּתְבוּנָם}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ho|chapter=13|verse=2}}, and {{GHGheb|text=עָרְמָם}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=5|verse=13}}. The examples, however, are for the most part uncertain, e.g. in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=28|verse=4}} the reading is simply to be emended to {{GHGheb|text=בִּכּוּרָה}}, and in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Zc|chapter=4|verse=2}} to {{GHGheb|text=גֻּלָּה}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=11|verse=9}} to {{GHGheb|text=מִדָּה}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Neh|chapter=5|verse=14}} to {{GHGheb|text=פֶּחָה}}. [See also, after prepositions, {{GHGpar|103|g}}.]

{{GHGmargin-letter|91|f}}
''Plur.'' 1st pers. {{GHGheb|text=־ָ֫ נוּ}}, in {{GHGterm|pause}} {{GHGheb|text=קִימָ֫נוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=22|verse=20}} (where, however, {{GHGheb|text=קָמֵ֫נוּ}} is certainly to be read); cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ru|chapter=3|verse=2}} [{{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=47|verse=10}}, cf. {{GHGpar|61|c}}, h], and so always {{GHGheb|text=כֻּלָּ֫נוּ|translate=all of us}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=42|verse=11}}, &c [cf. {{GHGheb|text=בָּנוּ}}, {{GHGheb|text=לָנוּ}}, {{GHGheb|text=אִתָּנוּ}}, {{GHGheb|text=עִמָּנוּ}}].

2nd pers. {{GHGterm|fem.}} {{GHGheb|text=כֶ֫נָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=23|verse=48.49}}.

3rd pers. {{GHGterm|masc.}} {{GHGheb|text=־ָ֫ מוֹ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=17|verse=10}} (on {{GHGheb|text=מוֹ}} in {{GHGheb|text=פִּ֫ימוֹ}} in the same verse, and in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=58|verse=7}} see l); {{GHGheb|text=־ָ֑ הַם}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=23|verse=6}}, according to Sievers probably to call attention to the reading {{GHGheb|text=כלהם}}. {{GHGterm|fem.}} {{GHGheb|text=־ָ֫ הְנָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=7|verse=37}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=16|verse=53}} (in {{GHGterm|pause}}); {{GHGheb|text=־ֶ֫ נָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=41|verse=21}}; {{GHGheb|text=־ֶ֫ נָּה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=30|verse=41}}; {{GHGheb|text=־ָ֫ נָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ru|chapter=1|verse=19}}; elsewhere generally in {{GHGterm|pause}} ({{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=21|verse=29}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=42|verse=36|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=8|verse=7}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=31|verse=29}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=39|verse=2}}); finally {{GHGheb|text=הֵן}} as suffix to a noun, only in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=3|verse=17}}.

For examples of singulars with plural suffixes see l.

{{GHGmargin-letter|91|g}}
'''2.''' In the ''plural masc.'' and in the ''dual'' the suffixes are to be regarded primarily as affixed to the original ending of the {{GHGterm|construct state}} ({{GHGheb|text=־ַ֫ י}}, cf. {{GHGpar|89|d}}). This ending, however, has been preserved unchanged only in the ''2nd fem.'' In most cases it is contracted to {{GHGheb|text=־ֵי}}, as in the ''constr. st.'' without suffixes (so throughout the plur. and in the poetical suffix {{GHGheb|text=־ֵ֫ יהוּ}} of the ''3rd sing. masc.''); in the ''2nd masc.'' and ''3rd fem. sing.'' it is {{GHGheb|text=־ֶי}} (cf. k). On the ''1st pers.'' and ''3rd masc. sing.'' see i.—Thus there arise the following<section end=par91 /><noinclude>
<references/></noinclude>
